**(d) Phase and outer-star directions, and a C3-symmetric seed.**
Two loose ends of the pilot: the phase directions (`β`, i.e. `Im γ`) and the
outer spatial stars (S2, S3) were only probed at tiny amplitude; and the
seed density is not C3-symmetric in the solver's 120° basis, so a
symmetric density was never measured. Build the C3-symmetrised version of
the seed (in the 120° basis, check positivity), measure it as a static
band, then explore phase and outer-star deformations around whichever
static seed is better.
